about: Real company photos used by the page-builder sections (scripts/migrate/content/page-sections.mjs). Sources are the live site's Webflow images (web/public/wf/a/), described in the 2026-10-13 asset audit (redesign/assets.md, section 3a). No stock images. `upload.mjs` copies each source here under `file`, uploads it to Sanity (idempotent: Sanity dedupes by content hash) and writes assets.json. `existing` lists photos that are already Sanity assets (service and post images); they are referenced by asset id and never re-uploaded.
